get.description: Retrieve details of a specific contract change using its unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for obtaining information about the status and type of a contract change, as well as any associated line item changes. It requires the 'contracts-read' scope for access.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to retrieve.

patch.description: Update an existing contract change in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a specific change identified by its changeId. The request must include the necessary fields to update the contract change, such as the name and any line item changes.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to update.

post.description: Accept a specific change to a commerce contract identified by the changeId. This operation is useful for finalizing proposed changes to contracts, ensuring that the modifications are applied and the contract is updated accordingly.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract change to accept.

post.description: Cancel a specific change request associated with a commerce contract. This operation is useful when you need to revoke a proposed or pending change to a contract. It requires the unique identifier of the change you wish to cancel.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the change to cancel.

post.description: Create a new contract in your HubSpot account using the CommerceContractsPublicApiService. This endpoint allows you to specify various contract details such as billing information, line items, and payment methods. The contract's effective date, currency, and other required fields must be provided in the request body. Successful creation returns the URL of the newly created resource.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve a specific contract using its unique identifier. This endpoint provides detailed information about the contract, including its status, line items, and other relevant properties. It is useful for accessing contract details for review or integration purposes.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to retrieve.

patch.description: Update an existing contract in your HubSpot account using the specified contract ID. This operation allows you to modify details of a contract, such as billing information, payment terms, and other properties. Ensure that the contract ID is valid and that all required fields in the request body are provided.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to update.

get.description: Retrieve a list of changes associated with a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for tracking modifications made to a contract over time, allowing you to audit changes and understand the history of a contract's amendments.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which changes are being retrieved.

post.description: Create a new change for a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to propose modifications to an existing contract, such as adding, updating, or removing line items. The changes can be specified in the request body and are associated with the contract identified by the contractId path parameter.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the change is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Generate a renewal quote for a specified contract in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to create a new renewal quote based on the contract identified by the contractId path parameter. The request must include a quoteTemplateId to specify the template for the renewal quote.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract for which the renewal quote is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Terminate a specific contract in your HubSpot account. This operation requires specifying the contract ID and a termination date. It is useful for ending contracts that are no longer needed or have reached their end of service.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contract to terminate.

recurringBillingPeriod.description: An object representing the period of recurring billing.

recurringBillingStartDate.description: An object representing the start date for recurring billing.

richTextDescription.description: An object representing the rich text description of the line item.

sku.description: An object representing the stock keeping unit (SKU) of the product.

variantId.description: An object representing the variant ID of the product.

currencyCode.description: The currency code in which the price is denominated, represented as a string.

maxQuantity.description: The maximum quantity applicable for this price entry, represented as a string.

price.description: The monetary value of the product or service, represented as a number.

currencyCode.description: The currency code in which the price is denominated, represented as a string.

maxQuantity.description: The maximum quantity for which this price is applicable, represented as a string.

price.description: The price value associated with the currency code, represented as an object.

prices.description: An array of price entries, each detailing the currency and price for the contract or line item.

pricingModel.description: The pricing model applied to the contract or line item. Valid values include 'FLAT', 'GRADUATED', 'STAIRSTEP', and 'VOLUME'.

prices.description: An array of PriceUpdateEntry objects, each representing a price entry with details such as currency code and price.

pricingModel.description: A string representing the pricing model used. Valid values include 'FLAT', 'GRADUATED', 'STAIRSTEP', and 'VOLUME'.

dealId.description: A string representing the ID of the deal associated with the contract change.

dealPipeline.description: A string representing the pipeline of the deal associated with the contract change.

dealStage.description: A string representing the stage of the deal associated with the contract change.

effectiveDate.description: A string representing the date when the contract change becomes effective, in 'date' format.

name.description: A string representing the name of the contract change.

prorating.description: A boolean indicating whether the contract change should be prorated.

quoteTemplateId.description: A string that identifies the quote template associated with the contract change.

type.description: A string that specifies the type of contract change. The default value is 'QUOTE'.

archived.description: Indicates whether the quote is archived. A boolean value.

archivedAt.description: The date and time when the quote was archived, in ISO 8601 format.

automatedTaxesEnabled.description: Indicates whether automated taxes are enabled for the quote. A boolean value.

buyerCompanyId.description: The unique identifier of the buyer's company associated with the quote.

buyerContactId.description: The unique identifier of the buyer's contact associated with the quote.

comments.description: Additional comments or notes associated with the quote.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the quote was created, in ISO 8601 format.

currencyCode.description: The currency code in which the quote is denominated.

customProperties.description: A map of custom property names to their values for the quote.

dealId.description: The unique identifier of the deal associated with the quote.

esignDate.description: The date when the quote was electronically signed, in ISO 8601 format.

esignNumSignersCompleted.description: The number of signers who have completed signing the quote.

esignNumSignersRequired.description: The total number of signers required to sign the quote.

expirationDate.description: The date when the quote expires, in ISO 8601 format.

feedback.description: Feedback or additional information related to the quote.

hubspotBillingEnabled.description: Indicates whether HubSpot billing is enabled for the quote. A boolean value.

id.description: The unique identifier for the quote.

language.description: The language in which the quote is presented.

lineItems.description: An array of line items included in the quote.

locale.description: The locale setting for the quote.

paymentEnabled.description: Indicates whether payment is enabled for the quote. A boolean value.

pdfDownloadLink.description: A link to download the quote as a PDF document.

quoteAmount.description: The total amount of the quote.

quoteNumber.description: The unique number assigned to the quote.

senderCompanyDomain.description: The domain of the sender's company associated with the quote.

senderCompanyImageUrl.description: The URL of the image representing the sender's company.

senderCompanyName.description: The name of the sender's company associated with the quote.

senderEmail.description: The email address of the sender associated with the quote.

senderFirstname.description: The first name of the sender associated with the quote.

senderJobtitle.description: The job title of the sender associated with the quote.

senderLastname.description: The last name of the sender associated with the quote.

senderPhone.description: The phone number of the sender associated with the quote.

showSignatureBox.description: Indicates whether the signature box is displayed on the quote. A boolean value.

status.description: The current status of the quote.

terms.description: The terms and conditions associated with the quote.

timezone.description: The timezone setting for the quote.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the quote was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
